headline: Bitcoin Drops 12% to Break 200-Week Moving Average Support
summary: Bitcoin declined 12%, breaking below its key 200-week moving average technical support level. The selloff marks one of only four such steep technical breaks recorded since 2013.
why: Bitcoin is the world's largest cryptocurrency by market value. Long-term technical trendlines like the 200-week moving average serve as critical benchmarks for institutional and retail crypto traders.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Breaching technical support levels accelerated automated stop-loss orders and momentum selling.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bitcoin fell 12% as technical selling picked up after breaking below its 200-week moving average support level.
